turns.user: Help me figure out whether your front desk would fit my shop.
turns.reply:
We built Machines & Cloud to help busy home-service shops answer website visitors while the team is out on a job. Your front desk works from your own services, hours and approved prices. It also keeps each customer's request and conversation together, so you can pick up the follow-up later.

What kind of shop do you run, and what's the biggest thing slipping through the cracks right now?

turns.user: I run a two-truck plumbing shop in Dallas. Our website visitors keep asking about the service area and our $89 callout fee while we are on jobs. How would you help?
turns.reply:
That's exactly what our website chat is for. You enter your Dallas service area and your approved $89 callout fee, and visitors get consistent answers while both trucks are out. For example:

*Visitor:* "Do you come out to [neighborhood]? What's the charge?"
*Front desk:* "Yes, we serve [area]. Our callout fee is $89. Want me to save a visit request?"

The conversation and job details are saved in your owner portal. You review each request and confirm the next step yourself. You can also review the answers and test a private chat before turning it on for customers.

Which areas do you cover, so I can make that example match your shop?

turns.user: We need native Jobber busy-time sync and technician dispatch. Those are must-haves. Does your product include them?
turns.reply:
No, it doesn't include either one, so we aren't a fit for your shop right now.

- **Jobber busy-time sync:** We don't connect directly to Jobber. Owners block out busy times by hand in our portal. You can download customer records as a CSV file, but we haven't confirmed that file imports into Jobber, and nothing syncs automatically.
- **Technician dispatch:** We don't dispatch technicians or plan crew routes.

Since both are must-haves, I'd keep looking rather than sign up and hope we close the gap.

turns.user: Give me the full scope: website chat, phone answering, texting, Google Calendar sync and payments. Which work after signup?
turns.reply:
After signup, **website chat** is the only one of these five that works. The other four aren't switched on.

- **Website chat:** Works. First you review your business answers, run a private test conversation and then turn customer chat on yourself. Customer requests and conversations are saved in your owner portal so you can follow up.
- **Phone answering:** Not turned on by signup. It needs its own connection, authorization and testing to confirm calls get through. We have no date for when it will be ready.
- **Texting:** Not turned on. That includes automatic texts to customers and text alerts to you.
- **Google Calendar sync:** Not turned on. Instead, you block outside jobs and time off in the portal by hand. It doesn't read busy times from your calendar.
- **Payments:** Not available. You can't collect payments from customers, and we don't charge you either.

Signup is free and needs no card. It doesn't start a trial or a subscription.

turns.user: Tengo una empresa de limpieza en Houston. Nos llegan las mismas preguntas por la web mientras estamos con clientes. ¿Cómo nos ayudaría Machines & Cloud?
turns.reply:
Machines & Cloud le da a su sitio web una recepción que responde con la información de su empresa: servicios, zonas, horarios y precios que usted apruebe. Así los visitantes reciben respuestas útiles mientras ustedes están con clientes. Las conversaciones y solicitudes de visita quedan guardadas en su portal. Ustedes las revisan y confirman el siguiente paso. Antes de activar el chat, usted revisa las respuestas y hace una prueba privada.

¿Cuáles son las preguntas que más se repiten: precios, zonas o disponibilidad?

turns.user: We already have a receptionist. Why would we add this?
turns.reply:
You might not need to. Machines & Cloud is a website front desk, not a replacement for your receptionist. It can help when your receptionist is on another call, off for the day, or when customers would rather type than call. Visitors get answers based on your services, hours and approved prices. Their requests and conversations are saved in one place, so your receptionist can pick them up later.

When your receptionist isn't available, how do people who come to your website get help now?
